included.name: Cloud Services/ Cloud ERP
included.description: Using an online network of remote servers rather than a local server or personal computer to store, manage, and process data.

included.name: Dashboard
included.description: An interface that shows critical performance metrics for your business process quickly and graphically.

included.name: Settings
included.description: A shared set of features/parameters that define the aspects of your system.

included.name: List Filtering (Faceted Search)
included.description: Allows you to refine searches based on multiple attributes like date, product code, category, brand, name, suppliers, warehouses, and payment status.

included.name: PDF Download and Export
included.description: You can download and share a copy of your virtual documents with other people by saving it in Portable Document Format (PDF).

included.name: Automatic Barcode Generating
included.description: Generates barcode directly form DrongoERP database for every product.

included.name: Toggle Fullscreen
included.description: Enhance focus and productivity in our ERP system with “Toggle Fullscreen” – a free feature that removes distractions, allowing you to work without interruptions in a clutter-free, immersive interface.

included.name: Currency
included.description: Empower your business with the Multi Currency feature. Easily manage multiple international and local currencies for import-export or multi-country operations, ensuring seamless financial transactions and enhanced flexibility.

included.name: Brand & Category
included.description: Effortless organize and classify your products. Crate unlimited categories and brands o streamline inventory management, enhance searchability. Elevate your business operations with strategic categorization for improved efficiency and inventory optimization.

included.name: Excel Download and Export
included.description: Enables you to export a copy of the selected data from DrongoERP to a CSV or an Excel format or stores the copied data in a file that can be opened in Excel.

included.name: Group Permission / Access Control
included.description: Define a group of users, or departments, to subsequently assign view and edit permissions. To grant each user access based on their roles or responsibilities.

included.name: Email Configuration
included.description: Drongo mail servers will use your credentials to notify you and send messages directly to your email.

included.name: SMS Configuration
included.description: Drongo servers will use your phone number to notify you and send messages directly to your phone.

included.name: Payment Gateway Config
included.description: Enables you accept credit card payments (in person or online) by transferring money between your merchant account and a payment processor.

included.name: Language Preference
included.description: Choose form 19 international and local language preferences in our ERP system. Enhance usability and foster global collaboration effortlessly with this versatile, user-friendly add-on.

included.name: Notifications
included.description: Stay one step ahead with our “Notification” feature. Get real-time stock quantity alerts and more, ensuring timely and informed actions for a streamlined ERP experience.

included.name: Profile
included.description: In our ERP system, you get a personalized “Profile” feature at no cost. Take control of your experience by managing your settings and information. Tailor your profile to suit your needs, optimizing your ERP journey with ease and convenience.

included.name: Unit
included.description: Ensures effortless and accurate product measure elements, and benefit from automatic conversion o sub-units. Seamlessly handle complexities like decimals and diverse units, simplifying logistics and optimizing business processes.
